summary: Adds new Resource-Priority namespaces for the Session Initiation Protocol and records them with IANA. They were created to meet the needs of a United States defense communications agency. The resource priority mechanism lets some calls be treated as more important than others.

eli5.summary: When phone lines are busy, some calls matter more than others. This note adds new priority labels so that important calls, such as ones from defense groups, can be marked and handled first.

questions: how to register a sip resource priority namespace
